vehicle_configuration: T-90A with PKTM coaxial machine gun and 6P49 Kord roof gun; earlier T-90/NSVT configurations are not mixed into this configuration.

sources.qualification: 850 m/s is a generic weapon specification, not a measured B-32 load in this T90A; the game's 2000-round loader is the vehicle supply pool, not one belt.
The sheet includes infantry mounts and an optional NATO cartridge variant; neither their weight nor 12.7x99 ammunition is applied to this tank.

sources.finding: Manufacturer identifies 6P49 Kord vehicle applications and PKTM production. This supports choosing the Kord T90-family configuration; the simplified model is not treated as proof of a gun serial variant.

sources.qualification: Related T90S-family ammunition stowage cross-check, not a claim that every T90A production batch is identical.

sources.type: scan/transcript of original Russian arms-industry catalogue
sources.title: Weapons and Technologies of Russia, XXI Century Encyclopedia, Volume XII, Ammunition and Destruction Means, 2006
sources.qualification: Use the Russian-language normal-incidence 20 mm / 100 m statement; the English translation conflicts with it. Cartridge catalogue V0 is a reference, not a T90A-specific chronograph measurement. Plate trials are not assumed to be calibrated Minecraft RHA tests.

The day 1x field is a wide rectangle with a central cross and horizontal/vertical strokes marking the magnified field. Screen dimensions and line lengths are an adaptation, not a calibrated optical reproduction.

game_mapping.purpose: Small headroom above the catalogue reference plate thickness under the existing game drag and velocity-dependent penetration model.
game_mapping.B32_is_not_tracer: Visible tracer alpha and light disabled; the incendiary component is not converted into an explosive blast.

network_limits: IOL staging diagram and initial ROE native-download attempts returned HTML/error pages. Those are not evidence files. Indexed original ROE PDF contents and the successfully downloaded Kotsch photographs were reviewed.
